workUnits.requiredOutcome: Add the exact accepted-source manifest and reconstruction-receipt contracts, canonical serialization, schemas, validation, compatibility, and migrations while composing existing architecture/plan/approval, artifact, generation receipt, package, version, migration, quality, and evidence identities.
allowedEdits: schemas/artifacts or bounded reconstruction schema area; Artifacts, Architecture, Development and serialization code; schema registry; fixtures/unit tests; documentation.
stopConditions: Stop if ownership cannot be expressed as exact non-overlapping paths, if generated/protected/editable meaning is ambiguous, if sensitive/operational state can become accepted source, or if new contracts duplicate an existing ProgramKit authority instead of referencing it.

verification.expectedObservation: Exact human-semantic, program-kit-generated, and declared-logic-seam entries validate and round trip; overlap, undeclared paths, invalid modes/owners/digests, forbidden accepted inputs, and merged structural/logic evidence fail.

workUnits.requiredOutcome: Compose accepted-source ownership into the current C# source/build gate and represent analyzer/gate/build-policy revisions and consumer dependencies in the existing version topology so reverse closure reaches every affected component without a parallel graph.
allowedEdits: Architecture ownership and quality/source-gate code; component version-map builder/manifests; analyzer/build-policy project imports/configuration; diagnostics; unit/conformance tests and fixtures.
stopConditions: Stop if topology needs a second graph, if generated header/path/receipt rules are weakened, if ownership is inferred from comments alone, if protected/generated edits can pass, or if analyzer/build-policy changes do not reach consumers through reverse fixed-point closure.

verification.expectedObservation: Exact ownership coverage and modes are mechanically checked; generated header/path/receipt and no-suppression rules remain; analyzer/build-policy version changes produce causal reverse closure to all fixture consumers.

workUnits.requiredOutcome: Compose the existing migration assessment into a complete human-reviewed corrective decision, reusing every exact disposition/action and adding only RepairImplementation and ReimplementDeclaredLogic if no semantic equivalent exists.
allowedEdits: Artifacts migration action enum/schema/profile/migrations only where semantically missing; Workbench migration assessment/decision composition; CommandLine assess flow if required; unit/conformance fixtures; documentation.
stopConditions: Stop if an existing action already carries the meaning, if a new disposition or workflow duplicates migration assessment, if any impacted node can remain undecided, if ProgramKit auto-selects an action, or if Blocked can proceed.

verification.expectedObservation: Unchanged-with-proof, incremental repair, regenerate, recompile/relock/retest, logic reimplementation, adapter, artifact/config migration, redesign, manual review, and blocked map to one complete human decision; missing/automatic/blocked decisions fail.

workUnits.requiredOutcome: Implement a human-started clean-room application reconstruction operation that requires an empty contained workspace and complete decision, prepares exact local ProgramKit packages/source mapping, materializes accepted protected/logic inputs, generates deterministic structure, restores/builds/tests, and emits a receipt only after atomic committed success.
allowedEdits: Workbench bounded reconstruction service/contracts; CommandLine reconstruction descriptor/composition/operation; local package/source-map composition; atomic output workspace/evidence; unit/conformance fixtures; command documentation.
stopConditions: Stop on a non-empty/uncontained workspace, incomplete/blocked decision, ambient ProgramKit or package source, project/source/include/hint/build-output coupling, undeclared source, structural edit by authored logic, non-atomic success, history rewrite/rollback, or any production/secret/infrastructure/deployment/release/feed operation.

verification.expectedObservation: An exact accepted set reconstructs from empty using local mapped packages only; ownership/source/build gates and selected tests pass; failures/cancellation emit no success receipt and never alter version history or external state.

workUnits.requiredOutcome: Prove repeatable clean-room identity with deterministic fixtures: two reconstructions from the same accepted set yield identical protected/generated structural bytes and digests, authored changes remain only in declared seams, no undeclared drift exists, and all partitioned receipt/evidence digests verify.
allowedEdits: Clean-room fixture inputs, accepted-source/version/decision/package manifests, expected structural/logic/final digests, positive/negative conformance tests, deterministic evidence and documentation.
stopConditions: Stop if proof relies on repository history, a pre-populated workspace, ProgramKit source/build outputs, undeclared files, skipped analyzer/tests, nondeterministic structural bytes, or excludes any required source-set/evidence partition.

verification.expectedObservation: Two empty-workspace runs match exact generated/protected structural tree digests, confine logic changes to seams, contain no undeclared source or ProgramKit coupling, and verify all accepted/package/topology/decision/generator/structure/logic/final/build/test evidence.

workUnits.requiredOutcome: Run isolated cross-model conformance, produce identity/causality/ownership/seam/test/risk review-surface evidence without line-count or behavioral-equivalence overclaim, publish canonical ProgramKit documentation, and close only the approved review set.
allowedEdits: Cross-model isolated fixture evidence, review-surface projection, claim limitations, canonical documentation, closure validation report, and exact review-manifest implementation-status update.
stopConditions: Stop if models receive different accepted inputs/tests, share mutable workspaces, edit outside seams, structural bytes differ, a passing test set is called general equivalence, line counts are used as risk/correctness metrics, or closure requires excluded production/provider/release/deployment/feed/autonomous work.

verification.expectedObservation: All tests pass; isolated model results preserve identical structure and ownership, record separate logic/final digests, pass the same exact bounded tests, expose causal review evidence, and make only supported claims.

trace.observableAcceptanceOutcome: Overlap, undeclared files, header misuse, protected/generated edits, or logic outside seams fail mechanically.

trace.observableAcceptanceOutcome: Only reviewed semantics, generation/logic inputs, package/version decisions, policies, and non-secret templates enter an empty reconstruction.

trace.implementationOutcome: Analyzer/gate/build-policy revisions are exact existing-topology nodes and reach consumers through reverse closure.
trace.observableAcceptanceOutcome: Fixture policy revision yields deterministic causal paths and a complete impacted set without a parallel graph.

trace.implementationOutcome: Existing migration dispositions/actions express unchanged, regenerate/recompile/relock/retest, adapter, migration, redesign/review/blocked and add only semantically missing repair/declared-logic actions.

trace.implementationOutcome: Every impacted node has one explicit human disposition/actions and incomplete or blocked assessments cannot execute.

trace.implementationOutcome: Clean-room reconstruction starts in an empty contained application workspace and consumes exact local ProgramKit packages through controlled source mapping only.

trace.implementationOutcome: Reconstruction order and atomic commit produce complete receipts only after ownership/source/build/test success.

trace.implementationOutcome: Receipts partition accepted source, package closure, topology/decision, generator/structure, human semantics, logic, final tree, build/analyzers/tests, and ownership evidence.

trace.implementationOutcome: History is preserved and production data/infrastructure/secrets/operations/deployment/release/feed publication/provider integration/autonomy remain excluded.
